mapper.sql: SELECT catalog_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, unit_price, tax_rate, min_order_qty, delivery_cycle, currency, price_effective_date, price_expire_date, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_supplier_catalog
mapper.select: WHERE del_flag = '0' AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND material_id = #{materialId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_supplier_catalog ( supplier_id, supplier_name, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, unit_price, tax_rate, min_order_qty, delivery_cycle, currency, price_effective_date, price_expire_date, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{specModel}, #{unit}, #{unitPrice}, #{taxRate}, #{minOrderQty}, #{deliveryCycle}, #{currency}, #{priceEffectiveDate}, #{priceExpireDate}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_supplier_catalog SET del_flag = '2' WHERE catalog_id IN #{catalogId}
